# CIDEX 2024 — 宁波德图科技有限公司 (Ningbo DeTooLIC Technology Co., Ltd.) — booth 2117

## Ringkasan

宁波德图科技有限公司专注于开发和销售面向系统的后端高频高速 EDA/CAE 仿真 设计工具，并致力于解决高频高速电路系统工作频率上升、密度提高和功耗增加带来的 电磁兼容性、信号完整性（SI）、功率完整性（PI）、热稳定性和机械可靠性等问题。 DetooLIC focuses on the development of system-oriented back-end high-frequency high-speed EDA/CAE simulation design tools, and is committed to solving the problems of electromagnetic compatibility, signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), thermal stability and mechanical reliability caused by the increase in operating frequency, component density and power consumption of high-frequency high-speed circuit systems.
